title: Bass drum technique: two beats versus four
summary: Explains playing two beats for the first half-chorus then four, with an off-accent on the bass drum to make the band swing.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: And the bass drum... During the time that you were a teenager and you were playing drums, you were starting out early, you were watching the other drummers, how they played... Did they use the bass drum, say, a constant beat [RAPS 4-4 TIME] -- something like that?

Yeah... Well, during that time, some of them used four beats. But what it's supposed to be, the right way is to use two beats. So I used two beats. Right now in fast numbers, the first chorus I use two beats. That's to steady the band, the tempo right there. But after the first half of the first chorus, in the second half of the first chorus, then I start using four beats. Then I keep it up until they finish the number. Fast or slow. I can play it better fast than I could slow. Slow numbers tire me out.

For a fast number, I'm right in there. I know what I'm supposed to do. I keep the tempos up. Don't get no faster, don't get no slower. On most of the songs, I do. Sometimes I'll get a little bit... I'll get the same way, too; I get carried away, you know.
When you were young, starting out as a drummer, if you played, say, two beats as opposed to four beats, were the two beats on, say, two and four, or would they be on one and three, or did it vary?
I used to... When I'm playing four beats...
Well, then, it's four to the bar.
...it sounds like two. And when I'm playing two, it sounds like four. But I accent on my third beat, and the accent on the third beat... Then I'm playing four.

Instead of me hitting the bass drum right down solid, I've got a little after-beat on the bass...on the bass drum, which would make it swing better. See, if you hit... When you're playing four, when you hit the bass drum right down the straight, it sounds the same thing. You can't give very much swing to the band, you know.
